item.title: Lady's Bedstraw (*Galium verum*)
item.description: Lady’s bedstraw (Galium verum) is a perennial herb with yellow, honey-scented flowers and needle-like leaves. It contains bioactive compounds with antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Traditionally, it is used to support the urinary system and care for impure skin, while research suggests promising effects, although clinical evidence remains limited.
